grammar.title: Breaking something with V + 坏
grammar.explanation: 坏 (huài) after a verb shows that the action ruined or broke something — "break, ruin, spoil" as a result. It's a classic resultative complement, always attached right after the verb.

grammar.title: Up to now with 至今
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 至今 + 还/仍然 + 没有/动词短语
grammar.explanation: 至今 (zhìjīn) means "up to now, so far" — it marks a situation that has continued from the past into the present. It's often paired with 还 or 没有.

sentences.pinyin: Háizi bǎ wánjù nòng huài le.
